rationale: Two durable-record updates: the core gap's knowledge conditions are broadened to the measured scope (two and three nodes, quorum-critical losses), and the compaction/attribution finding is promoted as knowledge with its sources. No new inference or execution.

knowledge.statement: In the accept phase the core has no self-initiated refresh of the leader's knowledge of a follower's acceptance: resend_messages_leader's Accept arm only re-Prepares peers that are not promised and resends a pending StopSign or its decide, resend_messages_follower's Accept arm is empty, and flush_batch_follower replies only when a batch flush itself advanced the accepted index. Measured consequence at two and three nodes: whenever the lost Accepted receipts are exactly those the write quorum still needs (one at two nodes, two at three), the entry stays undecided for at least 100 configured resend periods, the leader keeps its own acceptance plus nothing, and the only protocol traffic after the drop is heartbeats; a later unrelated proposal then decides the earlier entry within one step, and a new Prepare/Promise cycle would re-advertise the acceptance through handle_acceptsync's reply instead.
knowledge.conditions: Sequence Paxos driven only through tick() and message passing, 2 or 3 nodes, error-free memory storage, in-order delivery of everything except the deliberately dropped receipts, no further client proposal and no ballot change during the window (so the accept-sync re-advertisement path stays out).
knowledge.changed_premise: Conditions narrowed to two nodes before the three-node case existed; the measured scope is now two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses, and the mechanism statement is unchanged. The earlier revision and its two-node receipt remain available.

knowledge.statement: The actor layer owns the OmniPaxos instance (spawn_actor consumes it by value) and exposes no compaction path: no handle method and no Command variant reaches OmniPaxos::trim/snapshot and the actor never calls them, so a runtime-only user cannot discharge the duty the repository's compaction documentation states. On the failure side, a storage write error is fatal in the core (the write paths call expect(WRITE_ERROR_MSG), 'Error writing to storage.'), that panic happens inside the task spawn_actor launched with no join handle kept, and the layer's failure contract has no storage-error variant - the only value for an absent actor is AppendError::Shutdown / RuntimeProposeErr::Shutdown - so the death reaches callers as the same value as an orderly shutdown, with the core's message lost.
knowledge.conditions: omnipaxos_runtime actor layer over any core instance; for the failure side, a Storage implementation that returns an error from a write operation (the trait allows this and defines the operations as rolled back). Source-settled, not executed.
